name: fraud-detection-xgboost
description: Fraud scoring console: FastAPI + XGBoost API trained on PaySim, with a React frontend.

scripts.dev:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --reload-dir backend/app --port 8000 --no-access-log
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check backend && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.format:py: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --select I --fix backend && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format backend
